div.div: 7 انسدج He fell prostrate; fell upon his face; (O, K, TA;) like him who is prostrating himself in prayer: (TA:) [it may perhaps be a mistranscription for انسدح; which seems to be better known in this sense: but it is said to be] formed by transposition from انسجد and [so] اندسج. (TA.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
